reading.zh: 长期维护，按侵入性从低到高读：查组件版本 → 更新程序自己 → 把移出的 Mod 放进回收区 → 把库镜像进备份仓 → 最后是那条能阻断启动的远端公告通道。
reading.en: Keeping things healthy over time, from the least to the most invasive: check component versions → update the program itself → trash removed mods → mirror the library into a backup repo → and the remote announcement channel that can gate a launch.
